object_description: compact five-story building volume with a recessed terrace and stacked floors
design_condition: Placed at the northern corner as a hinge between the school and neighborhood, the vertically dense building preserves most of the meadow and trees while extending the site's path network.

positive.statement: The compact building volume acts as a hinge between the school area and the surrounding neighborhood.
The diagonal connection through the school area creates an urban connection to the buildings on Welschmattstrasse.
The spatially vertical densification preserves a large, contiguous and attractive area of parking space and trees.
The project cleverly continues the fine network of paths and supplements it with a new path axis.
The compact form makes the project fundamentally economical.
The compact volume has the lowest building envelope number.
The location of the foyer and auditorium on the third floor is a strong idea.

negative.statement: The five-story building appears alien and incongruous with the existing complex.
The project makes little statement about new outdoor uses.
The catering kitchen would have to be optimized, enlarged and moved to the day structures.
The music rooms are too small and have an unfavorable spatial geometry for music lessons.
The arrangement of the room program is not very convincing from the user's perspective.
The complex development situation results in a lot of traffic space, and the daily structure is difficult to organize.
Public access to the auditorium over three floors raises operational questions.
The escape route situation with only one escape staircase does not work and is unresolved.
